findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.trigger: Input that exceeds the buffer size (64 integers)
findings.assumptions: The input is not sanitized before being converted to integers and stored in the buffer. The user can input more than 64 integers, which could lead to a buffer overflow.

findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.assumptions: There is no evidence of OS command execution in the code. The input is used to fill an integer buffer and is not passed to any shell or command interpreter.

findings.title: Integer Overflow
findings.trigger: Input that causes atoi to overflow
findings.assumptions: The atoi function does not handle overflow conditions. If the input string represents a number larger than the maximum int value, it could result in an overflow.

findings.assumptions: There is no evidence of OS command execution in the code. The input is used to fill an integer buffer and is not passed to any shell or command interpreter.
